description: Traceprop-SS on realistic 3-table ETL credit risk schema. Disjoint feature groups: bureau cols 0-2, prev cols 3-5, app cols 6-7. No injected signal; labels driven by per-source risk factors.
schema: Realistic ETL joins: bureau rows -> count/overdue/amount aggregations; prev_app rows -> count/approval_rate/amount; application -> employment/region. Disjoint feature columns per table.
trak_space: 8-dim exact Gram solve (d_feat=8, no JL projection)
